$comment: Per-avatar voice profiles applied with ffmpeg to the single base Piper voice (pitch/formant shift + speed). They are different voices in tone and speed, not different speakers.

dino.description: Zora the baby dragon: bright, a little higher than the base voice

cat.description: Mimi the kitten: light, high and quick

dog.description: Bruno the pup: warm and a bit lower

bear.description: Teddy the bear: deep, slow and cuddly
